note: Floor enforced by tools/ci/check-coverage-floor.sh in the coverage CI job (issue #185). Current measurement: 78.3% over 17 instrumented src/ files; the percentage floor carries a small margin for gcov attribution differences between gcc versions. Raise the floor as coverage improves — never lower it to silence a failure. Baseline history: the #177 integration re-baselined this floor — the new dicom, ndn_dissector and avl suites widened instrumentation from 6 to 9 files, and the #200 hash_utils.cpp rewrite added defensive paths the suites do not yet exercise, moving the aggregate from 87.1% to 78.2%. The #241 core_engine suite widened instrumentation from 9 to 17 files (packet_processing.c, hash_utils.cpp and their link closure) at 78.3%; the instrumented-files floor was raised to 17 while the line floor stays at 76.0 pending future suites. The instrumented-files counter remains the guard against suites silently losing instrumentation. See docs/DECISIONS.md.
